verdict.rationale: Sierra's docs claim a build-once agent deployable across chat, phone, email, SMS, and "messaging," plus one-click publishing to ChatGPT. That covers the chat/email core of the story, but none of the named third-party channels is explicitly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit in-app/SDK embedding, Slack, WhatsApp, and social-channel support ("messaging" is unspecified), plus any independent or hands-on corroboration of omnichannel deployment.
